```{r, include=FALSE}
packages <- c("duckdb", "lubridate", "tidyverse", "dplyr", "readr", "arrow", "fst", "DBI", "janitor")

install_if_missing <- function(package) {
  if (!require(package, character.only = TRUE)) {
    install.packages(package, dependencies = TRUE)
    library(package, character.only = TRUE)
  }
}

sapply(packages, install_if_missing)

read_data <- function(file_path) {
  if (grepl("\\.csv$", file_path)) {
    return(read.csv(file_path))
  } else if (grepl("\\.parquet$", file_path)) {
    return(arrow::read_parquet(file_path))
  } else if (grepl("\\.fst$", file_path)) {
    return(fst::read.fst(file_path))
  } else {
    stop("Unsupported file format")
  }
}


write_files_to_duckdb <- function(files, tables_location, file_type, con) {
  for (file_name in names(files)) {
    file_path <- file.path(tables_location, 
                           paste0(file_name, ".", file_type))
    
    # Verify file exists before trying to read
    if (!file.exists(file_path)) {
      stop(paste("File not found:", file_path))
    }
    
    data <- as.data.frame(read_data(file_path))
    table_name <- files[[file_name]]
    duckdb::dbWriteTable(con, table_name, data)
    print(paste("Wrote table:", table_name, "from:", file_path))
    rm(data)
  }
}

normalize_id <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  
  x <- iconv(
    x,
    from = "",
    to = "UTF-8",
    sub = ""
  )
  
  x <- stringr::str_trim(x)
  x[x == ""] <- NA_character_
  
  x
}

normalize_rxcui <- function(x) {
  x %>%
    normalize_id() %>%
    str_replace("\\.0+$", "")
}

parse_mixed_date <- function(x) {
  parsed_date <- suppressWarnings(
    parse_date_time(
      as.character(x),
      orders = c(
        "ymd HMS",
        "ymd HM",
        "ymd",
        "mdy HMS",
        "mdy HM",
        "mdy",
        "dmy HMS",
        "dmy HM",
        "dmy"
      ),
      tz = "UTC",
      quiet = TRUE
    )
  )
  
  as.Date(parsed_date)
}
```

# Codes per condition: ICD-10 + SNOMED, de-duplicated, NAs removed
```{r}
get_codes <- function(cond, xwalk = icd10_snomed_crosswalk) {
  d <- xwalk %>% filter(condition == cond)
  codes <- c(d$icd10_target, d$snomed_concept_id)
  codes <- unique(as.character(codes))
  codes[!is.na(codes) & codes != ""]
}

conditions <- sort(unique(icd10_snomed_crosswalk$condition))
codes_list <- set_names(map(conditions, get_codes), conditions)

to_sql <- function(x) paste0("'", str_replace_all(x, "'", "''"), "'", collapse = ", ")
sql_list <- map(codes_list, to_sql)

short_names <- c(
  "Anemia" = "anemia",
  "Cardiovascular disease (baseline)" = "cvd",
  "CKD" = "ckd",
  "Dementia" = "dementia",
  "Diabetes mellitus type 1" = "dm1",
  "Diabetes mellitus type 2" = "dm2",
  "GI disease - IBD and intestinal malabsorption" = "ibd",
  "GI disease - peptic ulcer disease" = "pud",
  "Hyperlipidemia" = "hld",
  "Hypertension" = "htn",
  "Liver disease" = "liver",
  "Malignancy" = "malignancy",
  "MDD/Anxiety" = "mdd_anx",
  "Obesity" = "obesity",
  "Osteoarthritis" = "oa",
  "Osteoporosis" = "osteoporosis",
  "Pregnancy (active - censoring event)" = "pregnancy",
  "Pulmonary disease" = "pulm",
  "Rheumatoid arthritis and other CTD" = "ra_ctd",
  "Sleep disorders" = "sleep"
)
codes_short <- set_names(codes_list, short_names[names(codes_list)])
codes_long <- imap_dfr(codes_short, ~ tibble(condition_group = .y, code = .x)) %>%
  filter(condition_group != "pregnancy") %>%
  distinct()
sql_short   <- set_names(sql_list,   short_names[names(sql_list)])
if (dbExistsTable(con, "code_map")) dbRemoveTable(con, "code_map")
dbWriteTable(con, "code_map", codes_long, temporary = TRUE)
```

#import conditions, filter to eligible population
```{r data read and review}
cohort <- readRDS(paste0(output_folder, "cohort_outcomes.Rds"))
duckdb::duckdb_register(con, "cohort", cohort)

query_cond <- "
SELECT
    c.STUDY_ID,
    c.REPORT_DATE,
    c.ONSET_DATE,
    c.CONDITION,
    c.CONDITION_TYPE,
    m.condition_group AS diagnosis_group
FROM condition c
INNER JOIN code_map m
    ON c.CONDITION = m.code
WHERE c.STUDY_ID IN (SELECT STUDY_ID FROM cohort)
"

query_dx <- "
SELECT
    c.STUDY_ID,
    c.DX_DATE,
    c.DX,
    c.DX_TYPE,
    m.condition_group AS diagnosis_group
FROM diagnosis c
INNER JOIN code_map m
    ON c.DX = m.code
WHERE c.STUDY_ID IN (SELECT STUDY_ID FROM cohort)
"

condition <- dbGetQuery(con, query_cond)
dx <- dbGetQuery(con, query_dx)

```

# get first diagnosis date per condition

```{r}
dx_first <- dx %>% group_by(STUDY_ID, diagnosis_group) %>% slice_min(DX_DATE) %>% distinct()

condition$REPORT_DATE <- as.Date(
  parse_date_time(condition$REPORT_DATE, orders = c("ymd", "mdy"))
)
condition$ONSET_DATE <- as.Date(condition$ONSET_DATE)
condition$min_cond_date <- pmin(condition$ONSET_DATE, condition$REPORT_DATE, na.rm = TRUE)
condition_first <- condition %>% group_by(STUDY_ID, diagnosis_group) %>% slice_min(min_cond_date) %>% distinct()

dx_cond <- full_join(condition_first, dx_first)
dx_cond$first_dx_date <- pmin(dx_cond$min_cond_date, dx_cond$DX_DATE, na.rm = TRUE)
dx_cond$icd_code <- ifelse(is.na(dx_cond$DX), dx_cond$CONDITION, dx_cond$DX)
dx_cond <- dx_cond %>% select(STUDY_ID, diagnosis_group, first_dx_date) %>% distinct() %>% group_by(STUDY_ID, diagnosis_group) %>% slice_min(first_dx_date) %>% distinct()
dx_cond$STUDY_ID <- as.character(dx_cond$STUDY_ID)

cohort_dx <- left_join(cohort, dx_cond, by=c("cap_id" = "STUDY_ID") )
cohort_dx <- cohort_dx %>% select(cap_id, first_dx_date, first_tsh_lab, diagnosis_group) %>% distinct()

comorb_days <- cohort_dx %>%
  mutate(dx_day = as.numeric(as.Date(first_dx_date) - as.Date(first_tsh_lab))) %>%
  group_by(cap_id, diagnosis_group) %>%
  summarise(dx_day = min(dx_day), .groups = "drop") %>%      # earliest, in case of duplicates
  pivot_wider(names_from = diagnosis_group, values_from = dx_day,
              names_prefix = "dxday_")

saveRDS(comorb_days, "//cri-rss.cri.uchicago.edu/chess-lab/staff/rbaccile/Matt/output/comorb_days.Rds")

comorb_base <- cohort_dx %>%
  mutate(dx_day = as.numeric(as.Date(first_dx_date) - as.Date(first_tsh_lab))) %>%
  group_by(cap_id, diagnosis_group) %>%
  summarise(baseline = as.integer(min(dx_day) <= 0), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = diagnosis_group, values_from = baseline,
              names_glue = "{diagnosis_group}_base", values_fill = 0)

saveRDS(comorb_base , "//cri-rss.cri.uchicago.edu/chess-lab/staff/rbaccile/Matt/output/comorb_base.Rds")
```

# Medication covariates
```{r}
win <- cohort %>% ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
        # Calculate censoring date — minimum of 1 year after last TSH or last encounter
        censor_date = end_obs_date) %>%
  distinct(cap_id, episode_id, first_tsh_lab, censor_date) %>%
  transmute(cap_id, episode_id, win_start = as.Date(first_tsh_lab),
            win_end   = as.Date(censor_date))

rxcui_raw <- read_csv(rxcui_path) %>%
  clean_names()
rxcui_raw$rxnorm_cui <- as.character(rxcui_raw$rxnorm_cui)

rxcui <- rxcui_raw %>%
  select(rxnorm_cui) %>%
  unlist(use.names = FALSE) %>%
  normalize_rxcui() %>%
  discard(is.na) %>%
  unique()

prescribing <- read_csv(
  prescribing_path,
  col_select = c(
    STUDY_ID,
    RXNORM_CUI,
    RAW_RX_NDC,
    RAW_RX_MED_NAME,
    RX_ORDER_DATE,
    RX_DOSE_ORDRED,
    RX_DOSE_ORDRED_UNIT),
  col_types = cols(.default = col_character()),
  show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  transmute(
    cap_id = normalize_id(STUDY_ID),
    rxnorm_cui = normalize_rxcui(RXNORM_CUI),
    rx_date = parse_mixed_date(RX_ORDER_DATE),
    rx_dose = normalize_id(RX_DOSE_ORDRED),
    rx_dose_unit = normalize_id(RX_DOSE_ORDRED_UNIT),
    record_source = "prescribing") %>%
  semi_join(
    cohort,
    by = "cap_id") %>%
  mutate(
    matched_rxcui = (
      !is.na(rxnorm_cui) &
        rxnorm_cui %in% rxcui)) %>%
  filter(matched_rxcui)

prescribing <- left_join(prescribing, rxcui_raw)


cat_lookup <- tibble(medication_category = sort(unique(prescribing$medication_category))) %>%
  filter(!is.na(medication_category)) %>%
  mutate(var = paste0("rx_", make_clean_names(medication_category)))   # runs on ~20 unique values

rx_hits <- prescribing %>%
  select(cap_id, rxnorm_cui, rx_date, medication_category) %>%
  filter(!is.na(rx_date), !is.na(medication_category)) %>%
  inner_join(win, by = "cap_id") %>%
  filter(rx_date <= win_end) %>%
  mutate(rx_day = as.numeric(rx_date - win_start)) %>%
  group_by(episode_id, medication_category) %>%
  summarise(first_rx_day = min(rx_day), n_rx = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  left_join(cat_lookup, by = "medication_category")

# Wide table of first-prescription days, one row per episode
rx_days <- rx_hits %>%
  select(episode_id, var, first_rx_day) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = var, values_from = first_rx_day, names_prefix = "day_")
saveRDS(rx_days, '//cri-rss.cri.uchicago.edu/chess-lab/staff/rbaccile/Matt/output/meds_days.Rds')

# make sure every category has a column, even with no hits
all_vars <- paste0("rx_", make_clean_names(sort(unique(prescribing$medication_category))))
for (v in setdiff(paste0("day_", all_vars), names(rx_days))) rx_days[[v]] <- NA_real_


# Wide 0/1 flags, one row per patient (including patients with none)
flags <- rx_hits %>%
  mutate(flag = 1L) %>%
  select(episode_id, medication_category, flag) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = medication_category, values_from = flag,
              names_prefix = "rx_", values_fill = 0L) %>%
  clean_names()
rx_vars <- grep("^rx_", names(flags), value = TRUE)

# Add every patient, and every category even if it had no hits
all_cats <- paste0("rx_", make_clean_names(unique(map$medication_category)))

flags_all <- win %>% distinct(episode_id) %>%
  left_join(flags, by = "episode_id" )

flags_all <- flags_all %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(rx_vars), ~ coalesce(as.integer(.x), 0L)))

saveRDS(flags_all, '//cri-rss.cri.uchicago.edu/chess-lab/staff/rbaccile/Matt/output/meds_base.Rds')

```

# Weight covariate
```{r}
query_vit <- "
SELECT
    c.STUDY_ID,
    c.MEASURE_DATE,
    c.WT,
    c.ORIGINAL_BMI,
FROM vital c
WHERE c.STUDY_ID IN (SELECT STUDY_ID FROM cohort)
"

vitals <- dbGetQuery(con, query_vit)

vitals <-  vitals %>%
  transmute(cap_id = as.character(STUDY_ID), vital_date = MEASURE_DATE,
              weight = as.numeric(WT), bmi = as.numeric(ORIGINAL_BMI)) %>%
  inner_join(win, by = "cap_id") %>%
  filter(vital_date <= win_end) 

vitals$time_wt_start <- as.numeric(vitals$win_start - vitals$vital_date)

first_weight <- vitals %>% 
  group_by(episode_id) %>% 
  filter(!is.na(weight)) %>% 
  slice_min(abs(time_wt_start)) %>% 
  select(episode_id, win_start, weight, vital_date, time_wt_start) %>% distinct() %>%
  filter(abs(time_wt_start) < 90) %>%
  group_by(episode_id) %>%
  summarise(baseline_weight = max(weight)) %>% ungroup()

saveRDS(first_weight, '//cri-rss.cri.uchicago.edu/chess-lab/staff/rbaccile/Matt/output/weight_base.Rds')

vitals <- vitals %>% 
  filter(vital_date >= win_start&
           !is.na(weight)) %>% 
  group_by(episode_id, vital_date) %>%
  summarise(weight = max(weight)) %>%
  transmute(episode_id, weight_date = vital_date, weight) %>% ungroup()

wt_days <- vitals %>%
  inner_join(cohort %>% ungroup() %>% distinct(episode_id, first_tsh_lab), by = "episode_id") %>%
  mutate(wt_day = as.numeric(as.Date(weight_date) - as.Date(first_tsh_lab))) %>%
  filter(!is.na(weight), weight > 0, !is.na(wt_day)) %>%
  group_by(episode_id, wt_day) %>%
  summarise(weight = mean(weight), .groups = "drop")        # one value per day
saveRDS(wt_days, '//cri-rss.cri.uchicago.edu/chess-lab/staff/rbaccile/Matt/output/weight_tv.Rds')

```
